tasks.title: Discover concrete, evidence-backed improvements in omp-desktop and file them as tasks

evidence.detail: Initial discovery task. The AI worker must run the project's own quality gate (npm ci; npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm test; npm run build) plus cargo fmt/clippy/test, and only open follow-up tasks backed by a real failing check, a reproducible bug, or a measured regression. Never touch release/version/updater files.
